spec:
I would like you to implement a module named TopModule with the following
interface. All input and output ports are one bit unless otherwise
specified.

 - input  a
 - input  b
 - input  c
 - input  d
 - output out

The module should implement the Karnaugh map below. d is don't-care,
which means you may choose to output whatever value is convenient.

              ab
   cd   01  00  10  11
   00 | d | 0 | 1 | 1 |
   01 | 0 | 0 | d | d |
   11 | 0 | 1 | 1 | 1 |
   10 | 0 | 1 | 1 | 1 |

messages.content:
I would like you to implement a module named TopModule with the following
interface. All input and output ports are one bit unless otherwise
specified.

 - input  a
 - input  b
 - input  c
 - input  d
 - output out

The module should implement the Karnaugh map below. d is don't-care,
which means you may choose to output whatever value is convenient.

              ab
   cd   01  00  10  11
   00 | d | 0 | 1 | 1 |
   01 | 0 | 0 | d | d |
   11 | 0 | 1 | 1 | 1 |
   10 | 0 | 1 | 1 | 1 |

Write the complete SystemVerilog implementation of TopModule.
Respond with a single ```verilog code block containing the full module and nothing else.

content.text:
```verilog
module TopModule (
    input  a,
    input  b,
    input  c,
    input  d,
    output out
);

    assign out = a | (~b & c);

endmodule
```
